cases.name: secure-boot-without-microsoft-third-party-ca
cases.notice: Secure Boot is on, but this computer does not trust the Microsoft certificate Emaki starts with. In your firmware settings, turn on the third-party certificate option (often "Allow Microsoft 3rd Party UEFI CA") or turn Secure Boot off, then start the USB again.

cases.name: vmd-no-disk

hardware.disk_notice: No installation disk is visible behind the Intel storage controller (VMD/RST). In your firmware settings, disable VMD or Intel RST and select AHCI storage mode, then restart the USB. If another operating system is installed, prepare it for AHCI before changing this setting; otherwise it may stop booting.
